description: Long-term restoration begun 2009; moved into the Ahrens Hangar February 2014 and first engine run September 2014. Restoration described by the centre as almost complete.
Flown from Tyabb to Nhill in April 2018 as a permanent static exhibit.
Privately owned airworthy Tiger Moth (VH-RIN) added to the display in November 2017.
1930s Desoutter monoplane on loan from the Australian National Aviation Museum, Moorabbin.
